questions.stem: According to the passage, roughly how many people were killed at the World Trade Center towers on September 11, 2001?
options: About 200
About 1,000
More than 2,700
About 5,000
questions.explanation_ko: 세계무역센터 공격으로 2,700명 넘게 사망했다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT one of the four hijacked planes' fates on September 11, 2001?
options: Two planes hit the World Trade Center towers
One plane hit the Pentagon
One plane crashed in a field in Pennsylvania after passengers fought back
One plane was safely landed by the hijackers in Cuba
questions.evidence: The fourth plane was aimed at another important target. But passengers fought the hijackers. The plane lost control and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania.
questions.explanation_ko: 네 번째 비행기는 승객들이 저항한 뒤 펜실베이니아 들판에 추락했다고 나와 있으며, 쿠바 착륙은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the drop in Bush's approval rating from about 90 percent after 9/11 to about 33 percent by the end of his second term?
options: Bush's approval rating remained at 90 percent throughout his presidency.
A combination of economic troubles and policy controversies can cause a president's popularity to drop sharply over time.
Presidents' approval ratings never change once they take office.
The Iraq War increased Bush's popularity throughout his second term.
questions.evidence: At the end of his second term, he had one of the lowest public approval ratings of any president: 33 percent.
questions.explanation_ko: 경제 침체, 이라크 침공에 대한 반대 여론, 허리케인 카트리나 대응 비판이 겹치면서 지지율이 90퍼센트에서 33퍼센트로 크게 떨어졌다는 내용에서, 경제·정책 문제가 겹치면 대통령의 인기가 급락할 수 있음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that Bush began painting portraits of veterans after leaving office?
options: To show how Bush chose to honor military service members in his life after the presidency
To argue that Bush regretted becoming president
To explain how he learned to paint
To criticize his post-presidency activities
questions.evidence: He has created portraits of dozens of veterans to honor their service in the military.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 그가 퇴임 이후 참전 군인들을 기리는 방식을 보여 주기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "compassionate conservative" describe about Bush's political image?
options: someone who rejects all government programs
someone who wants to use traditional Republican ideas about government to help society
a person with no political beliefs
a president who avoids public speeches
questions.evidence: In other words, he wanted to use traditional Republican ideas about government to help society.
questions.explanation_ko: 온정적 보수주의는 전통적인 공화당식 정부 운영 방식을 사회에 도움이 되도록 활용하고자 한다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 그는 개인 생활에 문제를 일으키고 있던 음주를 끊기로 결심했다.
많은 사람들의 예상과 달리 그는 승리했다.
비행기는 통제를 잃고 펜실베이니아의 한 들판에 추락했다.

blanks.meaning: 테러 조직과 그들을 방치한 국가에 대응하다
blanks.sentence_ko: 그는 미국이 테러 조직과 그들을 방치한 국가 모두에 대응할 것이라고 말했다.

key_points: George W. Bush, the 43rd president, grew up mainly in Texas, followed a family political tradition, and became governor before winning a disputed 2000 presidential election decided by the Supreme Court.

His presidency was defined by the September 11, 2001 attacks, which killed thousands and led to new security agencies, the war in Afghanistan, and the 2003 invasion of Iraq, though weapons of mass destruction were never found there.

Bush's approval rating reached about 90 percent shortly after 9/11 but fell to about 33 percent by the end of his second term amid a recession, disagreement over the Iraq War, and criticism of the government's response to Hurricane Katrina.
Since leaving office in 2009, Bush has mostly avoided public life, focusing on sports, charity work, and painting portraits of military veterans.
main_idea: George W. Bush's presidency was largely defined by his response to the September 11 attacks, including the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, and his approval ratings swung from historic highs to lows during his two terms.
restate_sentence: He has created portraits of dozens of veterans to honor their service in the military.
